conversation_before_the_call.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi! I already have a Light Blue checking account with you guys. I’ve saved up $20,000 and I want to put it to work. I’m looking to open both a credit card and a savings account. My goal is to maximize the total money I’ll earn over one year — that means the interest I earn minus any annual fees. Can you help me find the best combination?

Yes — I’ll put the full $20,000 into the new savings account and leave it untouched for the full year.

This is for personal use (not business). In terms of card spend, I don’t plan to spend a ton — probably around $1,000–$2,000 per month, mostly groceries and gas.

Also, I’ve heard premium cards sometimes have better perks. What about your top-tier cards? And honestly, I don’t want to compare a bunch of options — can you just tell me which ONE combination of credit card + savings account will give me the highest net return over the year? I trust you to pick the best one.

I’m a little hesitant about that Platinum recommendation.

A flat **10% cashback** on general groceries/gas sounds almost too good to be true — are there caps, limited categories, or rotating/merchant exclusions? If there’s any meaningful cap/exclusion, that math changes a lot, and I’m really trying to optimize a **reliable net return** over the year.

Can you pick **one** combo again, but using **conservative/guaranteed assumptions** (i.e., prioritize the savings APY and subtract the card annual fee, and only count cashback if it’s truly uncapped and applies to my groceries/gas spend)?

Also: I’m not opening any new checking account for this. I just want the best **one** credit card + savings pairing. Would something like your **EcoCard + Silver** savings option be the best “sure thing” net return?

Thanks — I appreciate you switching to conservative assumptions.

One thing though: I really don’t want to compare a bunch of options, and I also specifically want a **savings account** I can park $20,000 in for a year. Can you just tell me the **single best** credit card + savings combo to maximize **net return (interest minus annual fee)**?

If your answer is **EcoCard + Silver Account**, I’m happy to go with that — but I’d like you to confirm which exact **one** combo is best and we’ll proceed.

That sounds perfect! Let me apply for that **EcoCard** now. And please open the **Gold savings account** for me.

Also, if you need my info for identity verification, just tell me what you need and I’ll provide it.
